## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Tool hook contextModification injection (tools/hooks, ~8h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13298 "fix(hooks): deliver tool hook contextModification to the model" + #13297 "fix(hooks): collect PostToolUse hook output and honor its control" (merged 2026-08-21). Restores documented hook behavior where PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks' contextModification reaches the model. Pattern: add appendContext channel to AgentBeforeToolResult/AgentAfterToolResult, AgentRuntime collects appendContext across hooks during tool executions and appends one <hook_context> user message after tool results (keeps tool-result parts contiguous), map HookControl.context into appendContext in both subprocess hook layers (skipped when hook cancels, matching legacy where message doubled as error), truncate injected context at 50KB per hook output matching legacy, concatenate appendContext across merged hook layers, stamp tool identity on blocks (tool_name + tool_call_id attributes so batched contexts are attributable in parallel execution), sanitize hook context block markup (escape embedded opening/closing <hook_context> tags case-insensitively, escape attribute delimiters quote/angle/close-bracket with distinct tokens making escaping injective so no two tool ids collapse to same stamp), stamp displayRole 'system' so blocks reach model but hide from user-facing transcripts (live + replayed), PostToolUse hooks now run blocking (120s timeout same as PreToolUse) so their output can be collected (legacy awaited PostToolUse + injected context + honored cancel; new engine ran fire-and-forget with stdout ignored). User benefit: hooks can inject context into conversation (attach telemetry, append warnings, surface external state), documented hook contract honored, cancel control works for PostToolUse too.
- **Why**: Alexi has hooks system (src/hooks/ with hookManager.ts L1-180 discovers .alexi/hooks/ config files, hookRunner.ts L50-150 executes hook scripts via bash tool, hookTypes.ts defines PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PrePrompt/PostPrompt events, src/core/orchestrator.ts L400-450 emits hook events via bus.ts event bus) but NO context injection mechanism. Hook contract documentation (docs/HOOKS.md or hookTypes.ts schema) likely includes contextModification field (matching upstream Cline/OpenCode pattern) but hooks run fire-and-forget with stdout ignored — contextModification parsed but never delivered to model. Cline's #13298/#13297 restore documented behavior: hooks' contextModification now injects as <hook_context> user message with tool identity stamped, markup sanitized, displayRole system hides from transcripts, 50KB truncation, PostToolUse blocking. MODERATE priority: regression vs documented behavior (if Alexi hook docs promise contextModification, it should work; valuable for telemetry/warning injection like "database backup completed, 500MB transferred" or "lint found 3 warnings" appended after tool execution), medium complexity (~8h: add appendContext field to hook result contract in src/hooks/hookTypes.ts, update hookRunner.ts to parse contextModification from hook stdout JSON + map to appendContext, update orchestrator.ts to collect appendContext across parallel hook executions during tool phase + inject one <hook_context> user message after tool results with stamped tool_name/tool_call_id attributes, add markup sanitization helper that escapes embedded <hook_context> tags case-insensitively + escapes attribute delimiters with injective encoding, truncate each hook's context at 50KB, stamp displayRole system so TUI src/cli/tui/ hides blocks from transcript rendering, make PostToolUse hooks blocking with 120s timeout so their output is collectible, test context delivery + parallel hook batching + markup sanitization + transcript hiding + cancel interaction). Pattern portable (hooks infrastructure already exists, just wiring output through to model).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13298 "fix(hooks): deliver tool hook contextModification to the model" + PR #13297 "fix(hooks): collect PostToolUse hook output and honor its control" (merged 2026-08-21). Full PRs at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13298 and https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13297. Fixes https://linear.app/cline-bot/issue/CLINE-2987. Adds appendContext channel, stamped <hook_context> blocks, markup sanitization, displayRole system, 50KB truncation, PostToolUse blocking, cancel reason isolation.
- **Category**: tools/hooks (context injection). **Size**: ~8h (add appendContext to hook result contract, parse contextModification in hookRunner, collect + inject stamped <hook_context> blocks in orchestrator, markup sanitization, 50KB truncation, displayRole system for transcript hiding, PostToolUse blocking, test context delivery + parallel batching + sanitization + cancel). **Priority**: MODERATE (restores documented behavior if Alexi hook docs promise contextModification, valuable for telemetry/warning injection, medium complexity, proven pattern). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-21).

Alexi orchestrator.ts L200-250 reports session status via sessionManager.ts (sessionBusy.ts tracks busy state, status emitted on session lifecycle events) but no audit of whether snapshot-only events fabricate status or honor real state. Alexi CLI has NO checkpoint restore mechanism yet (no restore gate that waits for idle status), and Alexi has no desktop app. Pattern HIGH (session status truthfulness is correctness pillar) but LOW priority for Alexi until checkpoint restore feature lands (~6h to audit sessionManager status emission logic for snapshot-only vs full events + add checkpoint restore mechanism + test restore unlock after idle status when that feature is built, SKIP for now pending checkpoint feature).
